detail: Octavian's fleet, commanded by Agrippa, defeats Antony and Cleopatra off western Greece.
label: 2 September 31 BCE
note: Added: your notes linked Antony's death to Actium; the battle itself was a year earlier.
title: Battle of Actium
tldr: Octavian's fleet beats Antony and Cleopatra. Within a year both are dead and Egypt is Roman.
